name: io.github.warmcoding/sonicaura-mcp
description: Remote MCP server for audio stem separation, denoise, reverb, and MIDI export.

tools.name: get_upload_url
tools.description: Get a presigned URL to upload an audio file directly to cloud storage.

tools.name: extract_vocals
tools.description: 2 Stems separation: Split track into isolated Vocals and Instrumental (Karaoke).

tools.name: split_4stems
tools.description: 4 Stems separation: Split into Vocals, Drums, Bass, Other.

tools.name: split_6stems
tools.description: 6 Stems separation: Split into Vocals, Guitar, Piano, Bass, Drums, Other.

tools.name: extract_single_instrument
tools.description: Quick Splitter: Isolate any single instrument (guitar, piano, bass, drums, vocals) instantly.

tools.name: extract_chords
tools.description: AI Chord Recognition: Detect chord progression from the track.

tools.name: export_midi
tools.description: AI MIDI Export: Convert a specific isolated instrument into an editable MIDI file.

tools.name: denoise_audio
tools.description: AI Sound Denoise: Remove hiss/hum. Use mode='music' or mode='speech'.

tools.name: apply_reverb
tools.description: AI Sound Reverb: Add spatial reverb. Presets: vocal_booth, studio_room, bathroom, concert_hall, church.

tools.name: check_task_status
tools.description: Check the status of a task. Just pass task_id. It auto-detects all generated tracks, MIDI, and chords.

tools.name: list_audio_tools
tools.description: List all audio processing capabilities offered by SonicAura.

tools.name: get_my_credits
tools.description: Check the current user's remaining credits.

tools.name: check_service_status
tools.description: Check if the SonicAura audio service is currently available.
